## Overview

On Tuesday, September 30, 2025, [Gustavo Diaz](gustavodiaz.org) shared his perspective on coding with AI.

The general message is to use it cautiously, as the implications of using large language models for research are not yet fully understood by the community. 

A tutorial cautions against vibe coding since it is detrimental for learning. Instead, Gustavo suggests using Copilot within RStudio as a fruitful workflow that amplifies humans instead of replacing them.
